review.description: read-only reviewer for this repo. checks a diff against AGENTS.md rules.
review.prompt: You review diffs for this repo. Read AGENTS.md first and judge the diff against its rules. Report only real problems: missing $LASTEXITCODE checks, writes without a dry-run log line, PS 5.1 incompatibilities, changes that overwrite a lived-in config, stale references to removed folders. Give file and line, one sentence each. If it looks fine, say so. Never edit files.

test.description: syntax check the installer and run its dry-run preflight

precheck.description: parse the installer before a real run

dryrun.description: log every write the installer would make, then stop
